preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 50,000.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of edges in the tree must be exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n for v, u in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertices in the edges must be within the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: len(colors) == n and all(c in 'WN' for c in colors)
preconditions.description: The colors string must have length n and contain only 'W' or 'N'.

postconditions.description: The output must be one of 'White', 'Draw', or 'Black'.
If there is at least one white vertex, the output cannot be 'Black'.

postconditions.expression: not any(colors[i] == 'W' for i in range(n)) and stdout == 'White'
postconditions.description: If there are no white vertices initially, the output must be 'White'.
